title: Meta quietly launches Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that helps users put together outfit ideas using clothes they own, in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand (Aisha Malik/TechCrunch)
summary: Aisha Malik / TechCrunch: Meta quietly launches Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that helps users put together outfit ideas using clothes they own, in Indonesia, Singapore, and Thailand — Meta has quietly launched Style Sketch, an AI fashion app that helps users put together outfit ideas using clothes they already own.
